rationale: Greek loanword παίδευσις with Lycopolitan ⲁⲉⲩ for δευ. Recurring lexeme on this page (lines 8-10) in the technical sense of catechetical formation — the παίδευσις of the catechumens by which they are instructed in righteousness.

Greek loanword κεράννυμι 'mix, blend' adopted into Coptic. Used in eschatological-mingling register (line 14) of catechumen souls being blended with their assigned places. Distinct from native ⲗⲱⲃϣ 'mingle' and from cosmological ⲥⲩⲛⲕⲣⲁⲥⲓⲥ in glossary.

Lycopolitan plural of Greek τύχη 'fortune, lot, fate.' Distinct from singular ⲧⲩⲭⲏ already in glossary (used naturalistically for the diver's varying success). Here in collective-eschatological register: the assigned fates of catechumens at judgment.
